name: Casio Computer Co.,Ltd.
summary: Casio Computer Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, production, sales, and services of watches, consumer products, systems, and other fields. It offers watches and clocks; consumer electronic dictionaries, calculators, electronic stationery, and electronic musical instruments; and molded parts and molds. The company also provides HR solutions and management support systems. It sells its products through retailers and distributors, as well as sales affiliates. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
